# Lexi YT 420 - Portfolio

Official portfolio website of Lexi YT 420, a professional Thumbnail Artist, Gamer, and Content Creator.

## Overview
This is a static portfolio website created to showcase professional YouTube thumbnail designs, creative work, and commission contact information.

## Tech Stack
- HTML5
- CSS3

## Pages
- /index.html
  Main landing page featuring the hero section, introduction, about section, and contact information.

- /works.html
  Gallery page showcasing professional thumbnail artwork and portfolio projects.

- /404.html
  Custom 404 error page for missing routes.

- /500.html
  Custom 500 error page for server-related issues.

## Assets
- /static/style/styles.css
  Main stylesheet for the website.

- /static/img/
  Image assets used throughout the website, including thumbnail categories and backgrounds.

## Thumbnail Categories
- Minecraft Thumbnails
- Normal Thumbnails
